title: Shared table color tokens live in theme.components.table
answers: Where do I set/override table header, row-stripe, row-hover, or row-selection colors?
Why is there both rowSelected and rowSelectedBackground on the table theme?
How do table cell/row colors get derived for custom themes?
body: theme.components.table (schema: ThemeTableColorsInputSchema in createComponents.ts) exposes headerBackground, border, rowStripedBackground, rowHoverBackground, and rowSelectedBackground as opaque colors computed in createTableColors() from the theme's generic colors (colors.secondary.main, colors.background.secondary, colors.action.selected, colors.warning.main, etc). rowHoverBackground is the single general hover token; components derive the hovered-selected-row look by emphasizing rowSelectedBackground, and cell focus uses theme.colors.action.selectedBorder — there is no separate hover-while-selected token. The legacy components.table.rowSelected is deprecated in favor of rowSelectedBackground and is slated for removal in Grafana 14; new table UI should read rowSelectedBackground, not rowSelected.
applies: Any component rendering table/grid rows, headers, or selection/hover states that reads theme.components.table.
